integrity: The proof is analytic for every finite group, every matrix size at least two, and every uniformity order at least two. The only external theorem used is the all-parameter Hanner lower bound proved in arXiv:2606.16862v2; the matching upper witness is computed directly from the defining derivatives. Finite code checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the full matrix-valued uniformity Banach space, not the Weyl-orbit quantum-uniformity subspace.
The result gives the exact modulus but does not classify every extremizing pair.
The Schatten-class Hanner inequality and its classical geometry are prior work; the contribution is the sharpness conclusion for the recently introduced matrix-valued uniformity setting.
title: Sharp modulus of convexity for matrix-valued uniformity norms
